maya: Quick sync 1: compact playground streaming controls. bug: Stop gets hidden when token chip wraps, so users can't interrupt. alex: saw this on small screens. stop icon gets squished under the token when sender name wraps. jordan: propose making Stop fixed-left in compact mode, Regen to the right. Token count collapses to a micro-dot or tiny number that expands on hover/focus. maya: priority: reliable interrupt affordance. token details can be secondary. sam: a11y: don't make token info hover-only. expand on keyboard focus and provide aria-label like "Tokens used: 42". add aria-live for streaming status. kevin: copy tweak: tooltip -> "Interrupt generation (Esc)" to surface shortcut. @design-bot any variants? design-bot: options: "Interrupt generation (Esc)", "Stop generating", "Cancel response". maya: picking "Interrupt generation (Esc)". alex: FE: moving Stop is straightforward. watch animation overlap with token meter; add small debounce on expand to avoid jitter. jordan: collapsed token could be "\u2022 42" that expands to a bar on focus/hover; aria-label reads numeric value. sam: sample snippet for spec: ```
Streaming
42 ``` kevin: product question: when users stop, show inline banner "Generation stopped partial response" with Retry? banner announced via aria-live. maya: yes to inline banner + Retry (same row, keyboard reachable). jordan: capture analytics: interrupt bucket (pre-first, mid, end). helps tune defaults. alex: regen button: long label is problematic in compact rail. consider icon+short label or icon-only with aria-label. sam: icon-only ok if focus ring and aria-name present. add keyboard tests. kevin: QA checklist: - compact: stop-left regen-right at 320px - token counter reachable via keyboard and hover - aria-live for stream start/stop and stop banner - Esc triggers stop and tooltip shows shortcut - analytics event for interrupt timing maya: i'll prototype and open PR, tagging @jordan @alex. jordan: figma 1-up? jordan: will drop variants (dot vs icon-only) by EOD. alex: i'll implement debounce and test cache overlap. sam: adding a11y tests. kevin: nice, should reduce confusion. :thumbsup: maya: thanks all linking PR when ready.
